content.text: I've updated the wiki with some RDF examples and outstanding questions:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Audit+Service+Implementation+Proposal#AuditServiceImplementationProposal-RDFVocabulary
I've also posted a message to the fedora-tech mailing list asking for feedback.

There are a few options, but I think it will be easy enough to switch between the different alternatives later as consensus forms, so this shouldn't get in the way of moving forward with implementation.
I've created a PR for adding a new ontology defining some audit types that aren't defined in PREMIS:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1422

This includes four event types suggested by UCSD that aren't present in PREMIS: metadata modification, content modification, derivative creation and indexing.  It also includes two OWL Classes for internal and external events.
I've updated the wiki pages that list the types and RDF vocab examples to use the new terms:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Audit+Service+Repository+Events+and+Agents
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Audit+Service+Implementation+Proposal#AuditServiceImplementationProposal-RDFVocabulary
Comments
Relating to:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Audit+Service+Implementation+Proposal#AuditServiceImplementationProposal-RDFVocabulary
What are you imaging the "#fixity1" hash resource will be in practice: <event1> premis:hasFixity <event1#fixity1>
, do you have a link to the PR mentioned in your comment above?
: Sorry about that, the PR is
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/pull/24
I don't have a strong opinion about what the event and fixity subject URIs should be.  As a strawdog, the internal audit and fixity URIs could be:
http://example.edu/rest/fcr:audit/49/07/f3/da/4907f3da-1994-422c-b97a-cc653045ddba
http://example.edu/rest/fcr:audit/49/07/f3/da/4907f3da-1994-422c-b97a-cc653045ddba#fixity
Resolved with:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/commit/53756a205e007d4d9f2dca55f9df0cab8f2ef69f
The Audit requirements includes guidlines for the properties and classes to use for recording audit information:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Audit+Service+PROV-O+vs+PREMIS
This ticket is to document the RDF that will be used to record audit events and gather community feedback:
Verify that these guidelines cover all of the required information in the Audit specification
Create a wiki page documenting the classes, properties and values that will be used
Post a message to the fedora-tech mailing list asking for feedback on the wiki page
